title: Salı akşamı

characters.WIFE: a woman of about forty with shoulder-length chestnut hair, wearing a cream knitted sweater and a long brown skirt
characters.HUSBAND: a man of about forty with short greying hair and glasses, wearing a burgundy sweater

scenes.text:
Evliliğin en güzel anı düğün değil,
sıradan bir salı akşamıdır.
scenes.prompt: On a rainy autumn evening, a small house with one warm glowing window, seen from the garden, wet golden leaves on the path and falling from a big tree.

scenes.text:
O yorgun gelir,
sen sormadan çayı demlersin.
scenes.prompt: On a rainy evening, {HUSBAND} steps in through the front door with a wet closed umbrella, looking tired, while {WIFE} in the warm kitchen behind him puts a teapot on the stove, smiling. Warm lamp light.

scenes.text:
Kumandayı ona bırakırsın,
o battaniyeyi sana.
scenes.prompt: {WIFE} on the left and {HUSBAND} on the right sit on a sofa under one shared woolly blanket, two cups of tea on the low table in front of them, rain on the window, warm lamp light.

scenes.text:
Ne çiçek var ne şarkı;
kimse bu anın fotoğrafını çekmez.
scenes.prompt: {WIFE} and {HUSBAND} sit quietly side by side on the sofa reading, a glowing candle and a teapot on the table in front of them, rain streaking the dark window, cozy lamp light.

scenes.text:
Ama aşk, işte bu salılarda büyür.
Bunu eşine gönder.
scenes.prompt: In the lamp-lit living room, {WIFE} rests her head on {HUSBAND}'s shoulder on the sofa, both smiling with closed eyes, a candle glowing on the table, rain and autumn leaves outside the window.

caption:
Eşin bunu bilmeli.

Büyük günler geçer, sıradan akşamlar kalır. 🤍

Bunu eşine gönder.
